author: Stimulating
body:
Don't expect me to be active, I'm not looking to play a lot. Preferably an English team. I'll play during TM time so don't worry about that lol. Basically upped my bow ability and still a pretty solid sword player despite my inactivity, though I'm not as good as I used to be now cuz of it. 

Also if you could be at least at the level where people aren't yelling and are somewhat organized that would be a plus. 

I play frontlines mainly 

I can do everything but offend (which I'm improving at and not too bad at now) in CTW and play melee in TDM 

Can also shotcall
